name: 23015 · Beaverdam, VA
findings: ZIP 23015 (Beaverdam) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23015 (Beaverdam) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
